title: O, for a Faith That Will Not Shrink
description: O, for a Faith That Will Not Shrink in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 520, “Prayer for Faith”, where the book credits them to the Bath Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O, for a faith that will not shrink Though pressed by ev-ery foe, That will not trem-ble on the brink Of a-ny earth-ly woe!

lines: O, for a faith that will not shrink
That will not tremble on the brink
A faith that shines more bright and clear
That when in danger knows no fear,
Lord, give us such a faith as this,
We'll taste, e'en here, the hallowed bliss

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1866.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
